title: True/false practice question (content format v2)
description: The four JSON columns of a question whose kind is 'true_false'. Scoring rule 'true-false-v1': score 1 when response.value (a JSON boolean) equals answer_key.correct, otherwise 0. A response that does not match $defs/response is not scored ('invalid_response'). CONTRACT ONLY: the server's sync function does not score this kind yet and app.question_revisions.kind does not accept 'true_false' yet.

response.description: What the phone sends as the learner's answer.

noInvisible.description: No invisible or direction-changing character: C1 controls (U+0080-U+009F), zero-width characters and direction marks (U+200B-U+200F, U+2060, U+FEFF), line and paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029), bidirectional embeddings, overrides and isolates (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069), and lone surrogates (U+D800-U+DFFF). The pattern must be evaluated in Unicode mode (ECMA-262 'u' flag), where the surrogate range only matches a surrogate that is not part of a pair.
